description: NASA SPACE ARCHIVE is an interactive digital observatory by team Os Primos for NASA Space Apps. It is a virtual museum that tells the history of space exploration through its machines: probes, rovers, orbiters and landers. Explore Moon, Mars, and Deep Space, navigate timelines and open mission files with five chapters: why it was created, how it arrived, technology, discoveries and legacy. We turn scattered NASA data into a human story to preserve abandoned spacecraft and inspire students today.
